STRATEGY: The parent uses a heuristic with early cooperation, retaliation to opponent defection, occasional probing, and late-game defection in the last 3 rounds. The trace simulates the parent and other population strategies against TFT, always C, always D, grudger, and late-defecting opponents. It proposes changes such as always defecting on the last round, probing to classify opponents, and adapting late-game defection based on whether the opponent retaliates.
